closingReason.description: Reason for closing the card contract (free text)

closingComment.description: Comment (free text) can be provided for closing the card contract.

closureDelayType.description:
The closing type of the card contract. 
Possible values:
- IMMEDIATE (at the current date)
- SCHEDULED (at future date)
- SCHEDULED_EXP_DATE (at the expiration date of the card)

closingDate.description: If the delay type is SCHEDULED, the closing date must be provided and must be a future date.
